name: Default contactless payment app
plain: The person picks which wallet app answers when they tap to pay.
meaning: Decides which company sits between the person and the terminal. Android lets any HCE wallet be default; iOS opened this in the EU.

android.note: Google Wallet is default on most phones.

ios.permission: HCE entitlement; Default Contactless App setting
ios.store_policy: EU DMA only; scope should be re-checked for later iOS releases
ios.note: Outside EU Apple Pay remains the only default.

limits.headline: Can answer when you tap to pay, after you pick it as the default wallet
limits.user_action: You choose a wallet in Settings, then hold your phone to a payment terminal
can: Pay at a terminal with a tap
Be chosen as default on Android in the contactless payments setting
Be chosen on iPhone in the EU through NFC and Secure Element settings
cannot: Become the default without your choice
Replace Apple Pay on iPhone outside the EU
Replace Google Wallet unless you pick it in Android Settings
limits.reach_label: Only when you tap to pay
limits.differs: Android lets you pick any wallet. iPhone allows other wallets only in the EU from iOS 17.4.

story.what_it_is: Lets you pick which wallet app answers when you tap your phone to pay.

marketing.name: Host card emulation
marketing.pitch: Google lets any approved wallet app act as a payment card over NFC and be the default.

marketing.name: HCE transactions in apps
marketing.pitch: Apple opened NFC payments in apps in the EU so other wallets can compete.

story.for_you: You tap your phone at a terminal and the wallet you chose pays. In settings you pick which app does it. The default wallet decides which brand sits between you and the shop.
story.for_makers: Banks and wallet makers want to be the default so you tap with their app. It gives them purchase data and loyalty, and platforms guard it carefully because of fraud.

use_cases.example: A person picks a bank's own wallet for tap to pay.
A bank wants its card to be the first one at the terminal.
A store wallet bundles loyalty points with a tap to pay.
A transit app taps at the gate with a wallet card.
A fake wallet app tries to be default, so stores review them.
A car key and payment app share a tap.
A wallet shows an offer from a store as you tap.

story.android_note: Google Wallet is the default on most phones. Any approved wallet can be default.
story.ios_note: Only in the EU can another wallet use the tap. Elsewhere Apple Pay stays the default.
